More recently, Monti et al. (2021) found a signiﬁcant association between the exposure to airborne atmospheric pollutants and
methylation at several clock genes in individuals with overweight and obesity. In particular, short-term exposure to airborne partic-
ulate matter induced higher methylation of CLOCK, CRY1, CRY2, and PER3, and lower of PER2 in the blood of people with obesity.
